purpose: Teach: 実地/旅費/引数/業態/格付け/送迎/旅客/打ち込ん

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 実地研修、本気で、絶対、新人、絶対、徹底させろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Hands-on training — I need you to enforce it absolutely, thoroughly with every new hire. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Clipped, direct authority. Rapid-fire delivery. No wasted breath. Each instruction lands with weight. Expectation of compliance is implicit.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の旅費、本気で、絶対、適正に、絶対、管理しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. Staff travel expenses are being managed with absolute precision and care. Thank you for the trust.
lines.style: Measured, respectful cadence. Steady eye contact. Each commitment is stated cleanly without embellishment. Slight warm nod at the closing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: プログラムの引数、本気で、絶対、正確に、絶対、設定しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Program parameters — set them accurately without fail. I'm relying on you to get this right.
lines.style: Crisp, no-room-for-error tone. Sharp attack on the directive. Brief pause before the final phrase to underscore the stakes.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新業態、本気で、絶対、業界で、絶対、注目、絶対、集めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. Our new business model is already drawing industry attention. I appreciate your confidence in us.
lines.style: Quiet pride underlying the formality. Steady delivery. The word 'already' carries slight lift—quiet satisfaction at delivering results early.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社の格付け、本気で、絶対、向上、絶対、目指せ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Our company's rating — push to raise it. I want us at the top. Make it happen.
lines.style: Forceful but not harsh. Short sentences. Emphasis on the goal, not the difficulty. Leans forward slightly with each directive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様の送迎、本気で、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. VIP client transportation is running flawlessly. The team is fully committed to that standard.
lines.style: Calm, factual confidence. No hesitation. Delivers the update as already-accomplished, not aspirational. Slight warmth at acknowledgment of team effort.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 旅客サービス、本気で、絶対、当社、絶対、最高水準、絶対、目指せ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Passenger services — I want us meeting the highest standard in the industry. Absolutely non-negotiable.
lines.style: Steady, uncompromising tone. Weight behind each phrase. Slightly slower pace than before. The finality of 'non-negotiable' closes with quiet force.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、絶対、業務に、絶対、打ち込んでくれております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. Our staff is fully engaged and giving their best every day. I'm grateful for the opportunity to lead them.
lines.style: Warm note of genuine gratitude beneath formality. Slower, more reflective than the earlier responses. Slight exhale of pride at the closing.
